members.name: performRequest
members.signature: @MainActor func performRequest(_ request: ASAuthorizationRequest, options: ASAuthorizationController.RequestOptions) async throws -> ASAuthorizationResult
members.comment:
Perform the authorization request with additional options.

For example, you can use ``SwiftUI/View/task(priority:_:)`` or
``SwiftUI/View/task(id:priority:_:)`` along with
``AuthenticationServices/ASAuthorizationController/RequestOptions/preferImmediatelyAvailableCredentials``
to perform an authorization request when the view appears:

    .task {
        async let request = authorizationRequest() // defined elsewhere
        let result = try await authorizationController
            .performRequest(
                request,
                options: .preferImmediatelyAvailableCredentials)

        switch result {
        // code to handle the authorization result
        }
    }

- Parameters:
    - request: The authorization request to perform.
    - options: Additional options to customize the behavior of the
      authorization controller.

members.name: performAutoFillAssistedRequest
members.signature: @MainActor func performAutoFillAssistedRequest(_ request: ASAuthorizationRequest) async throws -> ASAuthorizationResult
members.comment:
Perform the AutoFill-assisted authorization request.

Add the ``UIKit/UITextContentType/username`` text content type to the
account or login name field:

    TextField("User name", text: $username)
        .textContentType(.username)

Use ``SwiftUI/View/task(priority:_:)`` or ``SwiftUI/View/task(id:priority:_:)``
to perform an AutoFill-assisted authorization request when the view appears:

    .task {
        async let request = autoFillAuthorizationRequest() // defined elsewhere
        let result = try await authorizationController
             .performAutoFillAssistedRequest(request)

        switch result {
        // code to handle the authorization result
        }
    }

- Parameter requests: The AutoFill-assisted authorization
  requests to perform.

members.name: reportPublicKeyCredentialUpdate
members.signature: @MainActor func reportPublicKeyCredentialUpdate(relyingPartyIdentifier: String, userHandle: Data, newName: String) async throws
members.comment:
Report an update to a credential's name, such as when changing the user name on an account.
This information is shared with all password managers enabled in the system.
- Parameters:
    - relyingPartyIdentifier: Relying party (website) that the credential is saved for.
    - userHandle: User identifier.
    - newName: The new user name for the credential.
- Throws: `ASAuthorizationError` if the system failed to accept the update.
members.typescript: reportPublicKeyCredentialUpdate(relyingPartyIdentifier: string, userHandle: ArrayBuffer, newName: string): Promise<void>

members.name: reportUnusedPasswordCredential
members.signature: @MainActor func reportUnusedPasswordCredential(domain: String, userName: String) async throws
members.comment:
Report an unused password credential for a given domain and username. Password managers may remove or hide the password credential.
This information is shared with all password managers enabled in the system.
- Parameters:
    - domain: The website domain that the credential is saved for.
    - userName: The account user name.
- Throws: `ASAuthorizationError` if the system failed to accept the update.

members.name: reportUnknownPublicKeyCredential
members.signature: @MainActor func reportUnknownPublicKeyCredential(relyingPartyIdentifier: String, credentialID: Data) async throws
members.comment:
Report that a specific credential is unknown or no longer accepted. The credential may be removed or hidden by a password manager.
This information is shared with all password managers enabled in the system.
- Parameters:
    - relyingPartyIdentifier: Relying party (website) that the credential is saved for.
    - credentialID: An identifier that uniquely identifies this credential.
- Throws: `ASAuthorizationError` if the system failed to accept the update.

members.name: reportAllAcceptedPublicKeyCredentials
members.signature: @MainActor func reportAllAcceptedPublicKeyCredentials(relyingPartyIdentifier: String, userHandle: Data, acceptedCredentialIDs: [Data]) async throws
members.comment:
Report a snapshot of all the credentialIDs that will be accepted for a `userHandle`. Credentials not present in the `acceptedCredentialIDs` may be removed or hidden by a password manager.
Relying party may choose to perform this periodically, e.g. on every sign in.
This information is shared with all password managers enabled in the system.
- Parameters:
    - relyingPartyIdentifier: Relying party (website) that the credential is saved for.
    - userHandle: User identifier.
    - acceptedCredentialIDs: An array of identifiers that uniquely identifies the accepted credentials.
- Throws: `ASAuthorizationError` if the system failed to accept the update.
members.typescript: reportAllAcceptedPublicKeyCredentials(relyingPartyIdentifier: string, userHandle: ArrayBuffer, acceptedCredentialIDs: Array<ArrayBuffer>): Promise<void>

members.name: save
members.signature: @MainActor func save(password: ASPasswordCredential, for scope: ASAutoFillURLScope, title: String? = nil) async throws
members.comment:
Save or update a password credential to the user's preferred password manager in the system.

This functionality is equivalent to the saving behavior that occurs when submitting a form with a password field.
The credential will be associated with the scope.

- Parameters:
    - password: The password credential to save.
    - scope: The scope to associate this credential with.
    - title: A custom title that credential managers may use to name the account.
- Throws: `ASAuthorizationError` if the system failed to accept the update.
- Note: The scope's URL must be listed as an associated domain for Web Credentials for the current app _or_ the app must have the `com.apple.developer.web-browser` entitlement.

members.name: oneTimeCodes
members.signature: @MainActor func oneTimeCodes(preferredDuration: TimeInterval) async throws -> some AsyncSequence<ASVerificationCode, any Error>
members.comment:
Stream one-time codes received by the system.

When requested, the user may decide whether your app may receive one-time codes.
This stream will automatically disconnect after a period of time.

- Parameters:
    - preferredDuration: How long the stream should ideally remain connected. This duration is not guaranteed.
- Throws: `DeliveredVerificationCodesManager.VerificationError` if one-time codes can not be delivered.
- Note: Only enabled credential providers may call this method.

members.name: consumeOneTimeCode
members.signature: @MainActor func consumeOneTimeCode(_ oneTimeCode: ASVerificationCode) async throws
members.comment:
Mark a one-time code as "consumed" by the current process.

A code should only be marked as consumed if it was submitted to a service for the purposes of authentication.

Consuming a code will mark a code's containing message as read in the Messages and Mail apps.
Depending on the user's preference, this may also delete the code's containing message.

- Parameters:
    - oneTimeCode: The code to mark as consumed.
- Throws: `DeliveredVerificationCodesManager.VerificationError` if the system failed to accept the update.
- Note: Only consume codes that you submit to a service. You should make a best effort to ensure it is accepted before calling this.

declarations.name: SignInWithAppleButton
declarations.comment:
A control you add to your interface that enables users to initiate
the Sign In with Apple flow.

## Initialization

A SignInWithApple instance is initialized with a `SignInWithAppleButton.Label`,
an onRequest closure for configuring an authorization request,
and a onCompletion closure for handling the results of the authorization request.

   SignInWithAppleButton(
       .signIn,
       onRequest: { request in
           request.requestedScopes = [.fullName, .email]
       },
       onCompletion: { result in
           switch result {
           case .success(let authResults)
               print("Auth Success!")
           case .failure(let error)
               print("Auth Failed: " + printError)
           }
       }
   )

members.name: init
members.signature: nonisolated init(_ label: SignInWithAppleButton.Label = .signIn, onRequest: @escaping (ASAuthorizationAppleIDRequest) -> Void, onCompletion: @escaping (Result<ASAuthorization, any Error>) -> Void)
members.comment:
Creates an instance that displays a control to Sign in with Apple.

- Parameters:
    - label: The label set on the control (see `ButtonType`).
            Defaults to .signIn.
    - onRequest: Closure for configuring the authorization request.
    - onCompletion: Handler for a completed authorization request.
members.typescript: static init(label: SignInWithAppleButton_Label, onRequest: ((arg0: _AuthenticationServices_ASAuthorizationAppleIDRequest) => void), onCompletion: ((arg0: SDKHandle) => void)): Promise<SignInWithAppleButton>
